diagnostic_evidence.quote: Taking the completion and using \eqref{eq:gaussian_sobolev}, we have  \eqref{eq:gaussian_sobolev_characterization}.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof establishes that C^{k;p,2}_{B,γ,η}(X,Y) ⊂ W^{k,p}_γ(X,Y) and that the completion of C^{k;p,2}_{B,γ,η,A}(X,Y) equals D^{k,p}_γ(X,Y). From these facts alone, equality of spaces C^{k;p,2}_{B,γ,η,A} = C^{k;p,2}_{B,γ,η} does not follow: equal closures do not imply equal spaces. The claimed equality requires proving that every element of C^{k;p,2}_{B,γ,η}(X,Y) admits a sequence of cylindrical maps from C^{k;p,2}_{B,γ,η,A}(X,Y) converging in ‖·‖_{W^{k,p,2}_{B,γ,η}}. While Bogachev's density of cylindrical approximations in W^{k,p}_γ (referenced in the preceding remark) combined with the inclusion C^{k;p}_{γ,Cyl} ⊂ C^{k;p,2}_{B,γ,η,A} (from eq:cyl_in_A and norm equivalence on cylindrical maps) would close this gap, the proof's stated reasoning is a logical non-sequitur and the needed density hypothesis is not invoked.

failure_location.quote: Finally \eqref{eq:A=ambient_gauss} follows from the inclusion $C^{k;p,2}_{B,\gamma,\eta}(X,Y)\subset  W^{k,p}_{\gamma}(X,Y)$  (recall \eqref{eq:inclusions_gaussian_proof}) and the definition of $W^{k,p}_{\gamma}(X,Y)$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Explicitly invoke Bogachev's density result for cylindrical approximations in W^{k,p}_γ as a hypothesis (valid for Gaussian measures on separable Hilbert spaces). For each F ∈ C^{k;p,2}_{B,γ,η}, construct a sequence from C^{k;p}_{γ,Cyl} converging to F in the operator-norm Sobolev norm. Verify that convergence in the operator-norm version implies convergence in the HS-norm version (via ‖·‖_{HS} ≤ ‖·‖_{op} on cylindrical maps). Apply eq:cyl_in_A to place the approximants in the A-space, concluding F ∈ A-space and hence the equality.
issues.overall_effect: The equality claim (eq:A=ambient_gauss) asserting C^{k;p,2}_{B,γ,η,A} = C^{k;p,2}_{B,γ,η} and C^{k;2}_{B,μ,A} = C^{k;2}_{B,μ} is unproved as written. The completeness of these spaces under the given norm (claimed implicitly) is not established. Corollary th:UA_gaussian invokes this theorem, though the weaker fact (density of the A-space in the Gaussian Sobolev space) suffices for the corollary and is established independently.
issues.title: Unproved equality of Sobolev spaces in Gaussian characterization
issues.why_classification: The proof gap requires adding an explicit hypothesis (Bogachev's cylindrical density in Gaussian Sobolev spaces) and a multi-step argument involving norm comparisons on cylindrical maps and the inclusion eq:cyl_in_A—more than a routine local edit. However, the needed components are available in the paper's own discussion and standard literature, no global proof architecture changes, and the substantive claims (UATs in Gaussian Sobolev spaces) survive with the repair.
